title: Looking at photos: Coleman band at Mardi Gras and the Playhouse trio
summary: Russell and Williams look at photographs: Williams with Freddie Coleman's band at the Mardi Gras and a trio at the Playhouse on Bourbon and St. Louis, with talk of the location and the Paddock.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played
